author: Barrie Linch
text: 4.4 is not low. The message says it's going low so you wouldn't usually expect to feel hypo at 4.4. I do agree that it's way off your glucometer reading but I wonder if it settled down a little later. I would never take one particular CGM reading as a cause for concern, though.
